claim: Researchers about to start PhDs and postdocs face particular challenges as the world attempts to cope with the devastating impact of the COVID-19 pandemic.
source: As the world attempts to cope with the devastating impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, researchers about to start PhDs and postdocs face particular challenges.
evidence: This is the main assertion of the abstract, supported by the detailed examples and testimonials provided throughout the manuscript.

claim: Fabian Schwerdtfeger started as a PhD student at Radboud University Medical Center in the Netherlands two weeks before the lockdown in March.
source: Fabian Schwerdtfeger started as a PhD student at Radboud University Medical Center in the Netherlands just two weeks before the lockdown in March.
evidence: Direct statement about when Schwerdtfeger started his PhD position.

claim: Schwerdtfeger has been working at home on a literature review since the lockdown.
source: Since then he has been working at home on a literature review and learning to use image analysis software through online tutorials.
evidence: Direct statement about Schwerdtfeger's activities during lockdown.

claim: Schwerdtfeger has been learning to use image analysis software through online tutorials since the lockdown.
source: Since then he has been working at home on a literature review and learning to use image analysis software through online tutorials.

claim: Schwerdtfeger is worried that lockdowns will limit the amount of experimental work he can do before his PhD contract ends.
source: Schwerdtfeger is worried that the present lockdown, and any subsequent lockdowns or delays caused by future outbreaks of COVID-19, will limit the amount of experimental work he can do before his PhD contract ends.
evidence: Direct statement of Schwerdtfeger's concern.

source: In the Netherlands, one can only graduate with a PhD if one has a certain number of publications

claim: Schwerdtfeger believes schools should lower expectations concerning publications as an alternative to contract extensions.
source: Alternatively, schools should lower expectations concerning publications.
evidence: Direct statement of Schwerdtfeger's suggested alternative solution.

claim: Schwerdtfeger is from Karlsruhe in Germany.
source: At present Schwerdtfeger, who is from Karlsruhe in Germany, is not worried about not being able to see his family

claim: Schwerdtfeger is not currently worried about not being able to see his family.
source: At present Schwerdtfeger, who is from Karlsruhe in Germany, is not worried about not being able to see his family

claim: Not being able to see family could become a concern for Schwerdtfeger if the lockdown continues for more than a month.

claim: The mental stress of not being able to generate data during lockdown is significant.
source: And it is worse when you know that you should actually be generating data, so the mental stress is not to be underestimated.
